lua:
-- star shield: dodge hazards, collect 5 stars
fld={x0=4,y0=18,x1=123,y1=123}
mx=90
sc=30
sfr=18
dcool=40
dtime=7
dspd=3.4

function newp()
 return {x=60,y=70,w=8,h=8,sp=1.4,fx=0,fy=1,ddx=0,ddy=1}
end

function ov(a,b)
 return a.x<b.x+b.w and b.x<a.x+a.w and a.y<b.y+b.h and b.y<a.y+a.h
end

function bar(x,y,w,f,c)
 rectfill(x,y,x+w,y+4,2)
 if f>0 then rectfill(x,y,x+max(1,flr(w*mid(0,1,f))),y+4,c) end
end

function pop(x,y,c)
 add(pops,{x=x,y=y,t=10,c=c})
 if #pops>10 then deli(pops,1) end
end

function spawn_star()
 local px=player.x
 local py=player.y
 for i=1,24 do
  local x=8+flr(rnd(108))
  local y=24+flr(rnd(88))
  if abs(x-px)+abs(y-py)>60 or i==24 then
   return {x=x,y=y,w=8,h=8}
  end
 end
end

function spawn_meteor()
 local s=0.9+0.12*stars+rnd(0.2)
 local e=flr(rnd(3))
 local h={w=8,h=8,wr=20,ty=1,vx=0,vy=0,x=0,y=0}
 if e==0 then
  h.x=fld.x0-8
  h.y=24+flr(rnd(92))
  h.vx=s
  h.vy=(rnd(2)<1 and -0.4 or 0.4)*s
 elseif e==1 then
  h.x=fld.x1+1
  h.y=24+flr(rnd(92))
  h.vx=-s
  h.vy=(rnd(2)<1 and -0.4 or 0.4)*s
 else
  h.x=8+flr(rnd(108))
  h.y=fld.y0-8
  h.vy=s
  h.vx=(rnd(2)<1 and -0.35 or 0.35)*s
 end
 add(hz,h)
end

function edge_spot(h)
 local e=flr(rnd(4))
 if e==0 then
  h.x=fld.x0 h.y=26+flr(rnd(90))
 elseif e==1 then
  h.x=fld.x1-7 h.y=26+flr(rnd(90))
 elseif e==2 then
  h.x=10+flr(rnd(104)) h.y=fld.y0
 else
  h.x=10+flr(rnd(104)) h.y=fld.y1-7
 end
end

function spawn_chaser()
 local h={w=8,h=8,wr=40,ty=2,sp=0.5+0.04*stars,vx=0,vy=0,x=0,y=0}
 edge_spot(h)
 add(hz,h)
end

function finish(won)
 state=won and "win" or "over"
 music(-1,200)
 if won then sfx(3,3) else sfx(4,3) end
end

function go_title()
 state="title"
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(6,200,3)
end

function rs_play()
 player=newp()
 hz={}
 pops={}
 lives=3
 stars=0
 en=mx
 shield=0
 dcd=0
 dash=0
 invul=0
 shk=0
 deny=0
 mt=45
 t=0
 star=spawn_star()
 state="play"
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(0,200,7)
end

function _init()
 player=newp()
 hz={}
 pops={}
 star={x=60,y=90,w=8,h=8}
 lives=3
 stars=0
 en=mx
 shield=0
 dcd=0
 dash=0
 invul=0
 shk=0
 deny=0
 mt=45
 t=0
 state="title"
 sfx(-1,3)
 music(6,200,3)
end

function _update()
 t+=1
 if shk>0 then shk-=1 end
 if deny>0 then deny-=1 end
 if state!="play" then
  if btnp(4) then
   rs_play()
  elseif btnp(5) and state!="title" then
   go_title()
  end
  return
 end
 if invul>0 then invul-=1 end
 if shield>0 then shield-=1 end
 if dcd>0 then dcd-=1 end
 if dash>0 then dash-=1 end
 en=min(mx,en+0.6)
 local ix=(btn(1) and 1 or 0)-(btn(0) and 1 or 0)
 local iy=(btn(3) and 1 or 0)-(btn(2) and 1 or 0)
 if btnp(5) and dcd<=0 then
  dash=dtime
  dcd=dcool
  if ix!=0 or iy!=0 then
   local d=sqrt(ix*ix+iy*iy)
   player.ddx=ix/d
   player.ddy=iy/d
  else
   player.ddx=player.fx
   player.ddy=player.fy
  end
  if player.ddx==0 and player.ddy==0 then player.ddy=1 end
  sfx(1,3)
 end
 if dash>0 then
  player.x+=player.ddx*dspd
  player.y+=player.ddy*dspd
 elseif ix!=0 or iy!=0 then
  local d=sqrt(ix*ix+iy*iy)
  player.x+=ix/d*player.sp
  player.y+=iy/d*player.sp
  player.fx=ix/d
  player.fy=iy/d
 end
 player.x=mid(fld.x0+1,player.x,fld.x1-7)
 player.y=mid(fld.y0+1,player.y,fld.y1-7)
 if btnp(4) and shield<=0 then
  if en>=sc then
   en-=sc
   shield=sfr
   sfx(16,3)
   pop(player.x+4,player.y+4,11)
  else
   deny=24
   sfx(18,3)
  end
 end
 if ov(player,star) then
  stars+=1
  sfx(0,3)
  en=min(mx,en+20)
  pop(star.x+4,star.y+4,10)
  if stars>=5 then
   finish(true)
   return
  end
  star=spawn_star()
  if stars==2 or stars==4 then spawn_chaser() end
 end
 for i=#pops,1,-1 do
  pops[i].t-=1
  if pops[i].t<=0 then deli(pops,i) end
 end
 mt-=1
 local cap=stars>=3 and 12 or 8
 if mt<=0 and #hz<cap then
  mt=max(16,42-5*stars)+flr(rnd(8))
  spawn_meteor()
 end
 local hurt=false
 for i=#hz,1,-1 do
  local h=hz[i]
  if h.wr>0 then
   h.wr-=1
  elseif h.ty==1 then
   h.x+=h.vx
   h.y+=h.vy
  else
   local dx=player.x-h.x
   local dy=player.y-h.y
   local d=max(0.001,sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy))
   h.x+=dx/d*h.sp
   h.y+=dy/d*h.sp
   h.x=mid(fld.x0,h.x,fld.x1-7)
   h.y=mid(fld.y0,h.y,fld.y1-7)
  end
  if h.ty==1 and (h.x<fld.x0-24 or h.x>fld.x1+16 or h.y<fld.y0-24 or h.y>fld.y1+16) then
   deli(hz,i)
  elseif h.wr<=0 and not hurt and ov(player,h) then
   if shield>0 or dash>0 then
    if h.ty==1 then
     deli(hz,i)
    else
     h.wr=30
     edge_spot(h)
    end
    pop(h.x+4,h.y+4,12)
    shk=max(shk,3)
    sfx(17,3)
   elseif invul<=0 then
    hurt=true
    lives-=1
    invul=60
    shk=8
    sfx(2,3)
    pop(player.x+4,player.y+4,8)
    for j=#hz,1,-1 do
     local g=hz[j]
     if abs(g.x-player.x)<26 and abs(g.y-player.y)<26 then deli(hz,j) end
    end
    if lives<=0 then finish(false) end
   end
  end
 end
end

function _draw()
 cls(0)
 if state=="title" then
  rectfill(fld.x0,fld.y0,fld.x1,fld.y1,1)
  rect(3,17,124,124,13)
  local sb=40+flr(sin(t/100)*3)
  spr(12,60,sb)
  if t%24<16 then rect(59,sb-1,68,sb+8,10) end
  spr(4,60,96)
  print("star shield",42,24,10)
  print("arrows: move",40,56,7)
  print("o: shield -30",38,66,11)
  print("x: dash",50,76,9)
  print("collect 5 stars",34,86,6)
  if t%30<20 then print("press o",50,110,7) end
  return
 end
 local ox=0
 local oy=0
 if shk>0 then
  ox=flr(rnd(3))-1
  oy=flr(rnd(3))-1
 end
 camera(ox,oy)
 rectfill(fld.x0,fld.y0,fld.x1,fld.y1,1)
 for i=1,7 do
  local gx=fld.x0+i*16-8
  line(gx,fld.y0,gx,fld.y1,0)
 end
 for i=1,6 do
  local gy=fld.y0+i*16-8
  line(fld.x0,gy,fld.x1,gy,0)
 end
 rect(3,17,124,124,13)
 local bob=flr(sin(t/80)*1.5)
 spr(12,star.x,star.y+bob)
 if t%16<9 then rect(star.x-1,star.y+bob-1,star.x+8,star.y+bob+8,10) end
 for p in all(pops) do
  circ(p.x,p.y,11-p.t+2,p.c)
 end
 for h in all(hz) do
  if h.wr>0 then
   local wx=mid(fld.x0,h.x,fld.x1-7)
   local wy=mid(fld.y0,h.y,fld.y1-7)
   local wc=(h.ty==2) and 9 or 10
   if h.wr%8<5 then rectfill(wx,wy,wx+7,wy+7,wc) end
   rect(wx,wy,wx+7,wy+7,wc)
  elseif h.ty==2 then
   spr(2,h.x,h.y)
  else
   spr(5,h.x,h.y)
  end
 end
 if dash>0 then
  for i=1,3 do
   circfill(player.x+4-player.ddx*i*5,player.y+4-player.ddy*i*5,max(1,3-i),i==1 and 13 or 12)
  end
 end
 if invul==0 or invul%6<3 or dash>0 then
  spr(4,player.x,player.y)
 end
 if shield>0 then
  local sr=9+(shield%8<4 and 1 or 0)
  circ(player.x+4,player.y+4,sr,7)
  circ(player.x+4,player.y+4,sr+2,11)
 end
 camera()
 for i=1,3 do
  local hx=2+(i-1)*10
  if i<=lives then
   spr(7,hx,2)
  else
   rect(hx,3,hx+7,9,2)
  end
 end
 for i=1,5 do
  local sx=42+(i-1)*10
  if i<=stars then
   spr(12,sx,2)
  else
   rectfill(sx+2,5,sx+5,8,2)
  end
 end
 local sfc=(en>=sc) and 11 or 12
 if deny>0 and deny%4<2 then sfc=8 end
 print("sh",2,11,sfc)
 bar(12,11,54,en/mx,sfc)
 if shield>0 and shield%4<2 then
  rect(12,11,66,15,7)
 end
 local ddc=dcd<=0 and 10 or 9
 print("ds",71,11,ddc)
 bar(81,11,45,(dcool-dcd)/dcool,ddc)
 if state=="win" or state=="over" then
  rectfill(10,44,117,102,0)
  rect(10,44,117,102,state=="win" and 10 or 8)
  if state=="win" then
   print("you win!",48,52,10)
   print("all 5 stars",42,64,7)
  else
   print("game over",46,52,8)
   print("stars "..stars.."/5",46,64,7)
  end
  print("o: retry",48,80,11)
  print("x: title",48,90,6)
 end
end
title: 星盾闪避

design.core_action: 方向键在固定场地内移动，用两种闪避工具应对不断进入的流星与追踪者：O开能量护盾（18帧无敌并弹开来袭物），X向当前方向冲刺一小段（7帧快速位移且冲刺中免疫）。
design.goal: 在场地内的星星被吃到5颗即获胜（stars>=5 → win）。
design.risk: 护盾消耗90点能量中的30点，能量只缓慢回充（0.6/帧），能量不足时按O只发出拒绝音并闪红条；冲刺有40帧冷却。星星数越多，流星出现间隔从约42帧缩短到约22帧、速度提升，第2/4颗星后各出现一只追踪者；被打中扣1条命并有60帧无敌，命归零即失败。
design.controls: 方向键移动；O：开护盾（标题/结算画面为开始、重开）；X：冲刺（结算画面返回标题）。
design.scenes: title / play / win / over 四个状态，单一固定场地（4,18)-(123,123)，无滚动镜头，仅在受击时有抖动。
design.audiovisual: 标题用内置 gentle_loop（music 6，声道0/1），游玩用 Kajam 循环（music 0，屏蔽声道3留给音效）；音效：0吃星、1冲刺、2受伤、3胜利、4失败，自定义16护盾开启、17弹开/击碎、18能量不足拒绝。视觉：顶部心形生命、5个星星格、sh护盾能量条与ds冲刺冷却条、敌人生成前边缘闪烁预警（流星黄、追踪者橙）、护盾白色气泡、冲刺残影、吃星/受击扩散环、结算面板。
preserve: 宿主的单一项目入口与标题/摘要字段
未修改的内置精灵与音频资源
unresolved: 护盾30点消耗/回充速度与冲刺40帧冷却的手感仍待试玩验证
冲刺期间无敌是否过于宽松、第2/4颗星出现追踪者的难度曲线是否合适
